integrity: Original analytic calculation and complete finite contact-frame proof; elementary numerical checks are supplementary; no independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: No claims about unequal ball radii or three-or-more-ball intersections; the degenerate endpoint s=1 is treated only by a limit. Earliest global historical priority has not been conclusively established.
scientific_scope: All real center offsets 0 <= s < 1 and all integer ambient dimensions n >= 2; two congruent Euclidean balls. All competitor ellipsoids, not only symmetric competitors.
title: Exact John ellipsoids and contact latitudes of symmetric ball lenses in all dimensions
